note: The Justice Institute of British Columbia, added 2026-11-12 so its marks (the gallery's collection and the patches S56-O46 and S56-O36) have a body to belong to. A public post-secondary institute, filed under agencies and boards, the nearest kind the atlas has.

records.name: Justice Institute of British Columbia
records.description: Public post-secondary institute with a provincial mandate to educate and train public-safety professionals — police, corrections, sheriffs, paramedics, firefighters and emergency managers. Established in April 1978 by order in council under the College and Institute Act, a joint undertaking of the Ministries of Education and Attorney General.
records.establishedMeaning: by order in council under the College and Institute Act, as the Institute’s own reports give it; the order was not obtained
